**Role and Responsibilities of FSSAI:**
FSSAI (Food Safety and Standards Authority of India) is the statutory body established under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India, to regulate and supervise food safety.
*Responsibilities:* 
* Framing science-based standards for food articles.
* Granting food licenses and registrations to manufacturers/operators.
* Enforcing food safety regulations and conducting inspections.
* Promoting public awareness regarding food safety and nutrition.

**Labeling Requirements Prescribed by FSSAI:**
Every packaged food label must clearly display:
1. Name of the food and list of ingredients in descending order of weight/proportion.
2. Nutritional information (energy, protein, carbohydrates, fat content per 100g or serving).
3. Vegetarian (green dot) or Non-vegetarian (brown/red dot) logo.
4. Net quantity, batch/code number, and manufacturing/expiry date.
5. Name and complete address of the manufacturer/importer.
6. FSSAI logo and license number.
